content_html:
These terms apply to your use of Company Marketcap (company-marketcap.github.io). By using the site, you agree to them. If you don't agree, please don't use the site.

Using the calculators

You're welcome to use the calculators for free, for your own personal or business planning. You don't need an account.

Estimates, not advice

The calculators produce estimates based on the figures you enter and the assumptions explained on each page. They're for general information and education only. They aren't financial, investment, tax, legal or accounting advice, and they don't take your full circumstances into account.

Before making a financial decision, check the figures with your lender, plan provider, tax professional or another qualified adviser. Rules, rates and limits change, and your own situation may differ from the assumptions a calculator uses.

Accuracy

We work to keep the calculators and explanations accurate, and we test each formula before publishing it. Even so, we can't guarantee that every result or piece of information is complete, current or free of errors. If you spot a mistake, please let us know through our contact page so we can fix it.

The site's text, calculator code, design and branding belong to Company Marketcap. You may link to any page and share results you create for your own use. Please don't copy or republish substantial parts of the site, or its calculators, without permission.

Acceptable use

Please don't use the site in a way that disrupts it or its visitors. That includes attempting to break its security, overloading it with automated requests, or using it for anything unlawful.

Advertising and links to other sites

The site shows ads and may link to other websites. We don't control those ads or websites and aren't responsible for their content, products or practices. Our privacy policy explains how advertising works on the site.

No warranty

The site and calculators are provided "as is" and "as available", without warranties of any kind, to the extent the law allows. We don't promise that the site will always be available or free of errors.

Limitation of liability

To the extent the law allows, Company Marketcap isn't liable for any loss or damage arising from your use of the site or from relying on any calculator result or information on it. That includes financial losses from decisions made using the site.

Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. When we do, we'll change the "last updated" date at the top of this page. If you keep using the site after an update, you accept the updated terms.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of the United States.

Contact

If you have a question about these terms, please use the details on our contact page.
